opsproc.title: Datalink Control and Display Unit (DCDU) (procedures do not require ATC datalink)

item.para: ATC datalink communications (CPDLC, DCL, and OCL) are not available.
Associated ATC datalink Required Communication Performance (RCP / Initial Continental Performance for CPDLC) capabilities are lost.
For more information on aircraft capability on ATC datalink communication, .
For aircraft with the 4D Operations capability, 4D Operations are not permitted.
